_comment: Payloads emitted by the REAL helper/LaunchBox.swift, captured on this machine.
The approve and deny entries were produced by a human at the actual system
dialog during the 2026-07-26 spike (screenshotted); the check and usage
entries were captured directly. They live here so lib/approval.js is tested
against what the binary really prints rather than against an assumed shape:
if the Swift side ever changes its output, the test that reads this fails.
